long_description:
Step away from the noise of everyday life and give yourself permission to slow down. Our Women’s Refresh, Reset & Relaxation Retreat is a thoughtfully curated multi-day experience designed to help you recharge, reconnect, and indulge in simple joys. Spend your days moving gently, nourishing your body, enjoying meaningful conversation, and embracing unstructured time to do exactly what makes you happy — whether that’s lounging by the pool, reading a book, or treating yourself to a massage.

From yoga to afternoon tea, Italian cooking night, and a lively murder mystery dinner, this immersive, multi-day experience blends wellness, creativity, and indulgence to help you recharge—mind, body, and spirit.

________________________________________

✨ Day 1: Arrival & Welcome

Ease into the weekend at your own pace. Arrive between 4:00–7:00 PM and settle in with pool time, light bites, and a curated charcuterie spread.

At 7:00 PM, we’ll gather in the dining room for a relaxed, build-your-own salad dinner. Enjoy meaningful introductions and guided intention setting to ground your experience and connect with fellow guests.

The evening winds down as the first floor closes at 9:30 PM, inviting you into restful stillness.

________________________________________

🌿 Day 2: Restore & Indulge

Begin your morning with coffee, tea, fresh fruit, or a smoothie before an 8:30 AM yoga session.

After breakfast, the day unfolds with a balance of scheduled treatments and free time. Enjoy massages and/or facials throughout the day—offered in the library or out on the pool deck in the privacy of a secluded space—while also having time to relax however you choose. Lounge by the pool, unwind on the front porch, curl up with a book, or take a peaceful walk to the nearby Cincinnati Zoo.

Midday brings a vibrant taco bar lunch, followed by late afternoon tea with light bites served either in the parlor or poolside.
